info.name: My Morning News
info.description:
Every route of the My Morning News REST API (316 requests), one folder per resource group. Generated by src/Tools/apidocs/generate_postman.py from the server's OpenAPI document; the full reference is [REST_API.md](https://github.com/jchristn/MyMorningNews/blob/main/REST_API.md).

**Getting started.** Set baseUrl (default http://127.0.0.1:12100), tenantId, email, and password, then send **Token > Issue a session token**. Its test script stores token, userId, and tenantId. Every request then authenticates with the collection's bearer auth ({{token}}) unless it sets its own. Create requests store the new record's ID (topicId, runId, and so on) so the read, update, and delete requests that follow use it.

**Other credentials.** The Authentication examples folder shows an access key and secret, a signed request (MMN1-HMAC-SHA256, with a pre-request script you can copy), and the administration key (x-api-key).

**Conventions.** Lists take pageNumber, pageSize, sortBy, sortDirection, search, fromUtc, and toUtc, and return { items, pageNumber, pageSize, totalCount, totalPages, durationMs }. Errors are { error, message, requestId, details }. Optional query parameters are included but disabled; enable the ones you need.

**Running the whole collection.** The folders run top to bottom on a fresh stack: each folder creates its records and uses them, the Cleanup folder then deletes them (newest first), and the Run last folder signs out and restarts the server. Change my password sends the current password as the new one, and Update server settings sends back the settings that Read server settings returned, so a run leaves the administrator's password and the server's settings as they were. Requests for records a fresh stack does not have yet (runs, findings, briefings, audio) answer 404 until a run has produced some.

**Careful.** Requests that start runs, refinement steps, prompt lab runs, and model tests call the configured model and cost money. Run a topic uses dryRun=true by default. Delete requests delete, and the bulk deletes in Cleanup remove every matching record.

item.name: Token
item.description: Sessions. POST /v1.0/token exchanges login headers (an email and password, or an access key and secret) for a bearer token. The other routes validate, describe, refresh, and revoke the token you already hold.

header.description: Enable to also receive a refresh token.

request.description:
**Issue a session token.** Send x-email and x-password (x-tenant-guid optional: without it, a single matching tenant signs in and several return 409 with the tenant list), or x-access-key, x-secret-key, and x-tenant-guid. Send x-client: mobile to also receive a rotating refresh token.

- Auth: None. The login headers are the credential.

- Status: 200 OK; 400 BadRequest; 401 Unauthorized; 409 The email matches accounts in several tenants; the body is a TenantSelectionResponse. Sign in again with x-tenant-guid.; 429 TooManyRequests

item.name: Authentication examples
item.description: The other ways to authenticate besides a bearer session token: a credential's access key and secret, a signed request, and the administration key. Each request sets its own auth to No Auth and sends the headers itself.

exec: // Signs this request with MMN1-HMAC-SHA256 using the accessKey and secretKey collection variables.
// Copy this script to any request (and set its auth to No Auth) to sign it. The secret never leaves Postman.
const toSign = ["MMN1-HMAC-SHA256", method, pathAndQuery, tenantId, date, nonce, bodyHash].join("\n");

request.description: Lists one topic using a signed request. The pre-request script builds the string to sign (algorithm, method, path and query, tenant, x-date, x-nonce, and the SHA-256 of the body, joined by line feeds), signs it with HMAC-SHA256 keyed by secretKey, and adds the x-access-key, x-tenant-guid, x-date, x-nonce, and x-signature headers. Any auth mode except SessionExchange can sign. See [Signed requests](https://github.com/jchristn/MyMorningNews/blob/main/REST_API.md#signed-requests).

Lists one topic with a credential's access key and secret in headers. The credential's auth mode must be DirectHeader or Hybrid. See [Access keys](https://github.com/jchristn/MyMorningNews/blob/main/REST_API.md#access-keys).

Lists tenants with the server administration key. Add x-tenant-guid to call tenant-scoped /v1.0/api routes with it. See [Administration key](https://github.com/jchristn/MyMorningNews/blob/main/REST_API.md#administration-key).

**Stream a run's progress (server-sent events).** text/event-stream. Events: run (the run, on every change), stage (one stage, when it starts, progresses, or ends), ping (keep-alive every 15 seconds), and done (the final run; the stream then closes). A stream opens with the current run (when it is not finished) and every stage, so a reconnect needs no Last-Event-ID; for a finished run, the stages come first and done carries the run. Streams close after Rest.EventStreamMaxMinutes; reconnect to continue.

- Auth: `Run:Read` (`RunRead`).
- Response: text/event-stream
- Notes: Server-sent events: `run`, `stage`, `ping`, `done`, and `timeout`. See [Server-sent events](#server-sent-events).
